one held child and its descendants only: the RFD 0144 command placer in shadow (off unless the hidden cloud.autoCloud key is on) walks down from the session's agent process acpmux spawned through its threads' children files, never a /proc listing, and reads those processes' stat and socket fds, plus the listening TCP table, to record a shell call's peak memory, CPU and ports; nothing is decided from it (ask-59e410c353)

tagged DEV builds only (com.cmuxterm.app.debug.<tag>; Release and the next daily never start it): one ps listing after the app has exited, when no registry or socket is left to ask, to end the tree that build started (files-host pairs and the acpmux router never register); issue 55842

one held child only (the harness acpmux spawned) and, on macOS, its own descendants (at most 64, no other process listed): what its start did, read while the start runs, so a launcher (sr2 claude) or a harness waiting on page-ins is not called hung; Linux reads the same tree from that pid down (its /proc/<pid>/task/*/children links, at most 256, no /proc listing): each one's stat, running threads and comm, so a person's start of a harness that does no work ends there too; and on macOS the same descendants of that held harness (at most 1,024, one parent at a time) for a class change (set_tree_background: the dynamic class puts the tree in background class while the Mac is contended and takes it out after), nothing read from them

this process only: /proc/<own pid>/exe (std::process::id()), so the listener keeper runs this daemon's own binary even after an update replaced the file; not /proc/self because the path goes to systemd-run, which execs it as its own process (#56103); no enumeration
